ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
